scope: Every extra information boundary of the v1.4.0 baseline on the v1.5 development set (ten 39C3 excerpts plus the three former holdout talks with corrected labels), union of both backends.
method: Each event has a retained before/after pair and measured signals (text similarity and novelty to the previous state, changed-pixel share, state duration). Events were grouped by those signals and every group's pair sheets were inspected; the cause is assigned per group and recording type. Individual pairs were not all reviewed one by one.
